title: Missing values
recommendation: Review median or most-frequent imputation inside the training pipeline.
risk: No imputation strategy suits every dataset; whole-data imputation can leak validation information.

title: Potential outliers
explanation: Extreme observations are not necessarily errors.
recommendation: Review a box plot and original records.
risk: Deleting extremes can bias the data.
